sources.caption:
COMMUNITY HEALTH POST @ MYI

Knowing your vital signs, understanding your medications and making small, healthier lifestyle choices can go a long way in taking better care of yourself.

Starting Monday, 7 September 2026, the Community Health Post @ MYI will be available FREE for our community!

Come by and speak with the healthcare team to:
🩺 Learn how to monitor your vital signs
🥗 Get guidance on healthier lifestyle choices
💬 Receive personalised care & support planning
🤝 Connect with useful community resources and care services
💊 Get geriatric assessment & medication review

📅 Every first week of the month (except public holidays)
⏰ 9.00am – 12.00pm
📍 Masjid Yusof Ishak
👥 For ages 18 & above
💚 FREE

You can also refer a family member, friend or someone in the community who may benefit from this service.

👉 Register FREE:
www.tinyurl.com/myi-communityhealthpost

Please share this with your family and friends, it might be the little reminder someone needs to start taking better care of their health.
